Multiple choice questions

1. Which is the unit of work?
(a) Joule
(b) Newton
(c) Kelvin
(d) Watt

2. A body of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is kept at $20\text{ cm}$, $30\text{ m}$, $40\text{ cm}$ and $50\text{ cm}$ height respectively. At which position is its potential energy a maximum?
(a) $20\text{ cm}$
(b) $30\text{ m}$
(c) $40\text{ cm}$
(d) $50\text{ cm}$
